verdict.rationale: Deel's docs and marketing clearly describe EOR and global payroll across 150+ countries, contract creation via API, and a live confirmed use case (75 employees hired through Deel per community report), showing the core capability is real and used. However, independent hands-on accounts report significant operational friction — rigid workflows, poor customer support, forced Deel Wallet payment terms, and rising costs at scale — that temper the claim of a smooth EOR/payroll experience. Missing for 10: independent verification of compliance accuracy/on-time payroll performance and cost transparency at scale beyond marketing copy.
